rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, pretrain_steps=0, n_iter=100, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=1, lr=0.0003, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-10 SIX-BOX (HALFWAY). (1) PRIOR: iter-9 hr=0.0, unet_c=8 (down) gave rmse=0.00629, ssim=0.945 (highest ssim) -- no clear from iter-3's c=32 (rmse 0.00654). With c=8, c=16, c=32 ALL at hr=0, capacity is CONCLUSIVELY not the lever. Iters 1-9 all hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I regresses to the over-smoothed FBP mean; no edge-preserving structural guard (unlike the bilateral sibling's range kernel, hr~0.21). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-6 best reference (lr=3e-4, c=16, ep=3), n_iter 50 -> 100. Completes the inner-step sweep (iter-2/5 used 200, iter-6 used 50; this fills 100). (4) HYPOTHESIS: 100 inner steps is a middle ground -- enough to refine past the warm init but maybe not so many that it collapses fully to the smooth mean; if there is a sweet spot in inner-step count, rmse dips here. Per the ceiling, more likely rmse sits between the 50-step (0.00628) and 200-step (0.00633) values, still far above baseline 0.00521 (hr=0), confirming inner-step count is monotone-flat and not a lever. (5) BUDGET: 100 steps/scene, moderate; pretrain ep=3 + 200*100-step fits + figure ~= 16 min < 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-11 self-dispatched. Reserved levers: grad_clip off (2.0/none), seed variance check (314), lr=1e-4 very gentle, pretrain_steps cap, n_iter=400 high.
